title: OVAV Session Handoff Schema
description: Compact artifact that preserves session continuity across chat boundaries. Written at session end, loaded at session start. Multi-repo aware: each repo stores its own handoff.

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the repo this handoff belongs to

continuity_bridge.description: The essential context needed to continue without the user re-explaining

user_role.description: Sanitized role context: who we're working with (e.g., 'CEO of OVAV', 'Lead Developer')

phase_progress.description: Where exactly we are within the phase

last_decision.description: Last major decision or milestone reached

last_topic.description: What we were just talking about before the handoff

pending.description: Items explicitly left pending by the user

goal.description: The overarching task or goal spanning multiple sessions

user_preferences.description: What we learned about the user's communication style and preferences in this session

response_style.description: How the user prefers responses: compact, narrative, visual, etc.

feedback_notes.description: Specific feedback the user gave about delivery style

jargon_accepted.description: Technical terms the user is comfortable with

behavior_adjustments.description: Runtime behavior modifications learned during this session

ledger_snapshot.description: References to active ledger entries relevant to continuity

hash.description: SHA of this handoff content for tamper detection

repo_confirmed.description: Whether the repo root was verified at write time
